title: Memory pressure and recorded OOM
summary: Container resource limits and observed usage can establish a headroom breach. Engine OOMKilled records an OOM-associated lifecycle state; it does not establish the initiating allocation or full host pressure history.
checks: Compare configured memory limit and current usage with the declared headroom threshold.
Correlate host availability and independently approved kernel/cgroup aggregates at the incident time.
limitations: Usage includes cache; no trend, leak, CPU saturation or initiating cause is inferred from one sample.

source.documentation_version: Engine API 1.47 and rolling Docker documentation
